notes.note: Review round 1 fix: Continue now goes through useChatInput.sendComposedMessage -> sendMessage({ preserveComposer: true }); added that the draft, quotes, attachments and visual skill stay, a refusal restores nothing and a running turn makes it send nothing (not steer or queue). Checked against useActiveChatSessionMessaging (clearInput, attachment reset, submittedDraft, busy branch, skill-draft refusal all gated on preserveComposer) and the ChatDockBody identity lookup.

Added that anything being written stays in the composer, matching sendComposedMessage/preserveComposer; the rest of the continue-interrupted-turn row and paragraph re-read against the registry and ChatDockBody gate.

Added the composed-message exception: Continue's send writes the same invoking outbox row under its derived key (the attachment-stage condition is skipped for it), but a refusal hands nothing back and a running turn makes it not send, steer or queue (preserveComposer joins skipInMemoryQueueOnBusy's no-op return). Ordinary composer sends, the queue drain and the delivery lookup are unchanged.
Re-read after the settings.md wording change; the UI-only preview paragraph and the rest of the guide still match the registry and docs check.
sendMessage gained an optional preserveComposer flag used only by Continue; routing of managed chat through orchestration is unchanged.
useActiveChatSessionMessaging keeps its role as the chat send owner; the new preserveComposer option and useChatInput.sendComposedMessage add no module or dependency edge.
Form submission re-entry still uses the ordinary send without preserveComposer; the new option changes nothing described here.
No settings read or write changed in useActiveChatSessionMessaging; the approval-mode defaulting paths are untouched by preserveComposer.
Slash-command handling in sendMessage is unchanged; Continue's fixed text never starts with '/'.
ChatDockBody now calls sendComposedMessage for Continue; no configuration key or file changed.
No contracts change in the fix round: preserveComposer is a UI send option; the request body shape (message, clientTurnId, attachments) is the existing foreground contract.
No SDK export changed: sendComposedMessage and preserveComposer are src-ui internals over the existing sendExecutionMessage; clientTurnId rules here still hold for the continue-interrupted key.
The send still uses the foreground chat route and delivery lookup by clientTurnId; Continue's derived key is an ordinary caller-owned key under the documented 200-unit bound.

A composed message never carries the composer's visual skill and is not refused by its draft (preserveComposer skips the experience-draft gate); ordinary sends keep the documented explicit-send refusal unchanged.
ChatDockBody's Continue now uses the composed send; no concept described here changes.
Ordinary composer sends (handleSend) are back to their original behavior; sendComposedMessage is only Continue's. No getting-started flow changes.
No SDK package change; the README's chat send description is unaffected by the src-ui preserveComposer option.
